title: e2e2z store identity
description: The non-secret facts about cash.free2z.e2e2z's two store records that the release path must bind to but cannot discover. Every field that is null names something a human must create in App Store Connect or Google Play Console first; the release path refuses to sign or upload while any field it needs is still null, and says which one.

distributionIdentity.description: The codesigning identity the shared Corpora Apple Distribution certificate presents. Team-wide, not app-specific: this is the certificate ZUULI already signs with.

appStoreConnectRecord.description: Whether an App Store Connect app record exists for this bundle id. It cannot be created from the API; a human creates it in App Store Connect.

provisioningProfileName.description: The App Store distribution provisioning profile's name, exactly as it appears in ExportOptions.plist. Null until the App Store Connect record exists, because a profile cannot be issued for a bundle id with no record.

provisioningProfileUuid.description: The same profile's UUID, used to place and then prove the removal of the ephemeral profile on the signing runner.

playConsoleListing.description: Whether a Play Console listing exists for this package name. The Android Publisher API can only edit an app that already exists; a human creates it in Play Console.

uploadCertificateSha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the upload certificate whose private key signs the AAB, uppercase and colon-delimited, exactly as `keytool -list -v` prints it. Null until an upload key exists and Play Console has accepted it.

appSigningCertificateSha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate Play App Signing re-signs with, which is what assetlinks.json must carry. Play generates it: it is readable only from Play Console (Setup -> App integrity -> App signing) after the listing exists, and is one of the three values tracked in #461. It is recorded here for the assetlinks work; the release path itself never uses it.
